name: Spectrum Foods Limited
about: Spectrum Foods Limited manufactures and sells spices and industrial and edible salts in India. It offers various whole, ground, blended, and flakes spices, such as turmeric powder, red chlli powder, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fennel, fenugreek seeds, etc. The company serves industrial salts to chemical, powder, and textile industries. It also generates and sells electricity using wind and solar power project located in Ratlam District, Madhya Pradesh. The company was formerly known as Spectrum Leasing & Finance Limited. Spectrum Foods Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Jaipur, India.
